## [1.10.0](https://github.com/Edoardo9708/LegheFC-Morphe-Patches/compare/v1.9.0...v1.10.0) (2026-11-03)

### ✨ New Features

* **musicolet:** release Sync folder playlists ([1eccdfb](https://github.com/Edoardo9708/LegheFC-Morphe-Patches/commit/1eccdfbc548c539cb2250718068bcf22e59e07f5))

patches.name: DNS Changer - Force Pro test D2
patches.description: Test only: forces z() to return true and logs the forced value; does not change purchases.

patches.name: Flowx - Test stato Gold locale
patches.description: Inserisce dati dimostrativi Gold nella cache locale dell'app per verificarne il comportamento; non modifica l'abbonamento lato server.

patches.name: Fonometro - Remove ads
patches.description: Removes banner and interstitial ads without modifying Premium status, licenses, or in-app purchases.

patches.name: Yahoo Finance - Analysis diagnostics A7
patches.description: Logs finance analysis response status and local subscription access outcomes without changing results.

patches.name: Yahoo Finance - GOLD diagnostic A3
patches.description: Experimental: simulates GOLD in local subscription state. Server feature maps remain original; does not establish premium content access.

patches.name: Yahoo Finance - Remove ads A2
patches.description: Test: enables only the AdsFree UI check; leaves other subscription features and purchases unchanged. Logs YF-RemoveAds.

patches.name: Yahoo Finance - microG login A5
patches.description: Experimental: route Google identity sign-in/authorization to existing ReVanced GmsCore, using the bundled credential provider.

patches.name: Ski Safari – Unlock All Items
patches.description: Experimental: invokes ShopItemHelper.UnlockAllItems once through UnityPlayer's verified game-thread queue after the profile is ready. Includes local APK startup compatibility; native VM callbacks and save persistence require device verification.

patches.name: Sync folder playlists
patches.description: Create folder-linked playlists and add indexed tracks after scans. Existing-playlist folder selection is preview-only.

patches.name: Leghe FC - Avvio e nome 3 campo
patches.description: Corregge l'avvio dell'app e la rinomina in 3 campo.

patches.name: Leghe FC - Sblocca formazione suggerita e comparatore
patches.description: Formazione suggerita e confronto fra giocatori.

patches.name: Leghe FC - Sblocca percentuali
patches.description: Mostra le percentuali utili per scegliere chi schierare.

patches.name: Minigore 2 - Moltiplicatore monete
patches.description: Imposta il moltiplicatore delle monete guadagnate (x1-x1000) senza modificare prezzi o salvataggi. Include fix schermo Android 17 e debug per ripristino tramite ADB. Solo Minigore 2 v1.28 (28).

options.description: Inserisci un intero da 1 a 1000. Richiede la rigenerazione dell'APK.

patches.name: Prezzi Benzina - Remove ads A1
patches.description: Test: disables banner and interstitial ads without changing Premium, licenses or in-app purchases.

patches.name: Prezzi Benzina - microG token routing F13
patches.description: Local test: route only Maps ApiTokenService to the existing app.revanced.android.gms and declare the original public certificate digest. No Frida; use alone, not with F5-F12.
